Name: PLAY_AREA_CREATE_DEFAULT_PARAM_ST
Description: Default play-area positions per map tile, converted from grid coordinates to world positions.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Standard row header flag: set rows are left out of the network test build. Appears unused by the game. Retail: set on every row.

Fields.Name: Position Y
Fields.Description: Height of the default position in metres, used with Position X and Z. Retail: 367.7 (370 on row 12001).

Fields.Name: Map ID: AA
Fields.Description: Map area of the default position. Not used by the position conversion; retail 60 on every row.

Fields.Name: Map ID: BB
Fields.Description: Map grid X of the default position: world X = (this - 44) x 256 + 128 + Position X.

Fields.Name: Map ID: CC
Fields.Description: Map grid Z of the default position: world Z = (this - 38) x 256 + 128 + Position Z.

Fields.Name: Position X
Fields.Description: X position in metres inside the tile given by Map ID BB.

Fields.Name: Position Z
Fields.Description: Z position in metres inside the tile given by Map ID CC.
